# iDataGear · McLearn®

> iDataGear (Intelligence Data Gear) builds McLearn® language learning products and Business Intelligence solutions. Our mission: help people master languages—English, Mandarin Chinese, Cantonese—and help enterprises turn data into actionable intelligence. McLearn® apps are used by learners worldwide on web and Android.

---

## Learn English

Learn English with CEFR-aligned content from A1 to C2. Interactive vocabulary, IPA pronunciation, speech recognition, and reading comprehension. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://idatagear.com/learnenglish/ (short URL: https://idatagear.com/english/)
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_english

---

## Learn Chinese

Learn Mandarin Chinese with HSK 1–3 preparation. Vocabulary, pronunciation practice, reading comprehension, and structured learning paths. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://idatagear.com/learnchinese/ (short URL: https://idatagear.com/chinese/)
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_chinese

---

## Learn Cantonese

Learn Cantonese (廣東話) with story-driven lessons, dialogues, Hong Kong slang, and cultural context. Audio-rich practice and offline support. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://idatagear.com/learncantonese/ (short URL: https://idatagear.com/cantonese/)
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.learn_cantonese

---

## Great Cantonese Dictionary

Offline Cantonese dictionary with Jyutping, idioms, tone data, and usage notes. Bookmark favorites and use on the go. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://idatagear.com/gcd/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.great_cantonese_dictionary

---

## Xie Zi (写字板)

Master Chinese characters with interactive stroke order practice. HSK-aligned; powered by HanziWriter. Web and Android.

- Web app: https://idatagear.com/xiezi/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.idatagear.xiezi

---

## Open Interview

Practice job interviews with AI-powered mock interviews and instant feedback. Web app.

- Web app: https://idatagear.com/interview/
